body:
This PR fixes the Box links for the `twostr_test` and `water_conservation_test` artifacts.

Also, see https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaArtifacts/pull/188. closes https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaLand.jl/issues/1915
title: Fix Box links for artifacts

body:
## Purpose

Switch ClimaLand to the 0.25° MODIS LAI artifacts of CliMA/ClimaArtifacts#186, which hold the LAI of the *land part* of each cell, aggregated from the 0.05° MODIS data over land only. The current 1° artifacts count water as LAI = 0, so the LAI of coastal and lake-side cells is too low by their land fraction: for example 1.2 instead of 4.0 m² m⁻² (2000–2020 mean) in the 1° cell of the GF-Guy FLUXNET site, which is 14% land. ClimaArtifacts#186 describes the method and its validation.

## Changes

- `Artifacts.toml`: replace `modis_lai`, `modis_lai_climatology` and `modis_max_lai` with `modis_lai_0.25deg`, `modis_lai_climatology_0.25deg` and `modis_max_lai_0.25deg`.
- `src/Artifacts.jl`: the MODIS path helpers point to the new artifacts and file names (`Yuan_et_al_YYYY_0.25x0.25.nc`, `modis_lai_climatology_0.25x0.25.nc`, `modis_max_lai_0.25x0.25.nc`). Their names and signatures are unchanged, so `prescribed_lai_modis`, `prescribed_climatological_lai_modis`, `modis_max_lai`, `get_maxLAI_at_site` and `get_modis_lai_obs_var` read the new data without other changes.
- `experiments/calibration/observation_map.jl`: `process_member_data!` passes its `short_names` to `get_calibration_obs_var_dict`, which it calls only to check the names, so it no longer loads the 21 years of MODIS LAI for every ensemble member when `lai` is not a calibration target.
- NEWS entry.

The variable (`lai`) and the time axis (12 values 30 days apart from January 1) are the same as before. LAI is stored as `Int16` with `scale_factor = 0.001`, which NCDatasets, ClimaUtilities and ClimaAnalysis unpack to `Float32`. Ocean cells are now filled from the nearest land cells instead of being NaN; the leaderboard (`_land_intersection_mask`) and the calibration (`make_ocean_mask`) mask with the simulation's land, so this does not change which cells are compared.

## Checks

Run locally with the `.buildkite` environment, downloading the artifacts from Box:

- `prescribed_lai_modis` (2008–2009, including the year boundary), `prescribed_climatological_lai_modis` (including 2050, outside the data) and `modis_max_lai` on a 101 × 101 global box: on land, LAI between 0 and 6.7, no NaN. `modis_max_lai` on land ranges from 0 to 6.70, against 0 to 6.62 with the previous artifact.
- `get_maxLAI_at_site` in 2010: 4.45 at GF-Guy, 3.87 at US-MOz.
- `get_modis_lai_obs_var()`: 1440 × 720 × 250 months, 2000-01 to 2020-10, longitudes −179.875 to 179.875, latitudes −89.875 to 89.875, no NaN, maximum 6.83.
- `test/standalone/Vegetation/spatial_parameters.jl` and `test_optimal_lai.jl` pass.

## Cost of the LAI observations

At 0.25° the data has 16 times more cells. `get_modis_lai_obs_var()` takes 30 s, allocates 17 GB and peaks at 8.4 GB of memory. The leaderboard loads it once per run. A calibration with `lai` as a target still loads it once per ensemble member and iteration in `process_member_data!`, only to check the names; loading it once per iteration would be a follow-up.

## Before merging

- [ ] Copy the three artifacts to the central cluster and update `Overrides.toml`
